req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-020 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type header is exactly 'text/html; charset=utf-8' and body contains key Swagger identifiers to catch mutations that change the route path or response type; (4) additional DT — verifying exact status code 200 (not 201, not 204) to kill status-code constant mutations; (5) additional NEG — GET /docs/ (trailing slash variant) behavior is distinct from /docs to catch path-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialized with Swagger UI enabled (default)
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.content) > 0

test_swagger_ui_get_docs_returns_200()

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_response_content_type_is_html
expected: Response body contains 'swagger' (case-insensitive) indicating Swagger UI HTML
trace: R-TASK-020: interactive Swagger UI — payload must be HTML with Swagger content
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_response_content_type_is_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "text/html" in content_type
    body_lower = r.text.lower()
    assert "swagger" in body_lower

test_swagger_ui_response_content_type_is_html()

preconditions: GET /docs is registered but POST /docs is not
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 405 (Method Not Allowed)
trace: R-TASK-020 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error — wrong method is a client error

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_openapi_json_linked_in_docs
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialized with title 'Task Manager API'
GET /openapi.json endpoint is registered by FastAPI
actions: Assert body references the openapi.json spec URL
Also verify GET /openapi.json returns 200 with correct title
expected: openapi.json body contains title 'Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-020: interactive Swagger UI must link to the OpenAPI spec; DT covers the combination of /docs serving HTML that references /openapi.json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_openapi_json_linked_in_docs():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_docs = client.get("/docs")
    assert r_docs.status_code == 200
    assert "openapi.json" in r_docs.text
    r_spec = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r_spec.status_code == 200
    spec = r_spec.json()
    assert spec["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"

test_swagger_ui_openapi_json_linked_in_docs()
